legal_units.title: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
legal_units.text: Irrespective of anything contained in section 93, the following amounts shall not be deductible in computing the income of any assessee chargeable under the head "Income from other sources":—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter IV COMPUTATION OF TOTAL INCOME Chapter IV, Division F Income from Other Sources Section 94 Ministry of Finance, Government of India Section 94(1): Irrespective of anything contained in section 93, the following amounts shall not be deductible in computing the income of any assessee chargeable under the head "Income from other sources":—

legal_units.title: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
legal_units.text: any personal expenses of the assessee; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter IV COMPUTATION OF TOTAL INCOME Chapter IV, Division F Income from Other Sources Section 94 Ministry of Finance, Government of India Section 94(1): Irrespective of anything contained in section 93, the following amounts shall not be deductible in computing the income of any assessee chargeable under the head "Income from other sources":— Section 94(1)(a): any personal expenses of the assessee; or

legal_units.title: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
legal_units.text: any interest chargeable under this Act, payable outside India, on which tax has not been paid or deducted under Chapter XIX-B; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter IV COMPUTATION OF TOTAL INCOME Chapter IV, Division F Income from Other Sources Section 94 Ministry of Finance, Government of India Section 94(1): Irrespective of anything contained in section 93, the following amounts shall not be deductible in computing the income of any assessee chargeable under the head "Income from other sources":— Section 94(1)(b): any interest chargeable under this Act, payable outside India, on which tax has not been paid or deducted under Chapter XIX-B; or

legal_units.title: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
legal_units.text: any payment chargeable under the head "Salaries", if it is payable outside India, unless tax has been paid or deducted under Chapter XIX-B.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter IV COMPUTATION OF TOTAL INCOME Chapter IV, Division F Income from Other Sources Section 94 Ministry of Finance, Government of India Section 94(1): Irrespective of anything contained in section 93, the following amounts shall not be deductible in computing the income of any assessee chargeable under the head "Income from other sources":— Section 94(1)(c): any payment chargeable under the head "Salaries", if it is payable outside India, unless tax has been paid or deducted under Chapter XIX-B.

legal_units.title: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
legal_units.text: The provisions of sections 29, 35(b)(i), and 36 shall apply in computing the income chargeable under the head "Income from other sources" as they apply in computing the income chargeable under the head "Profits and gains of business or profession".
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter IV COMPUTATION OF TOTAL INCOME Chapter IV, Division F Income from Other Sources Section 94 Ministry of Finance, Government of India Section 94(2): The provisions of sections 29, 35(b)(i), and 36 shall apply in computing the income chargeable under the head "Income from other sources" as they apply in computing the income chargeable under the head "Profits and gains of business or profession".

legal_units.title: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
legal_units.text: For an assessee, being a foreign company, the provisions of section 59 shall apply in computing the income chargeable under the head "Income from other sources", as they apply in computing the income chargeable under the head "Profits and gains of business or profession".
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter IV COMPUTATION OF TOTAL INCOME Chapter IV, Division F Income from Other Sources Section 94 Ministry of Finance, Government of India Section 94(3): For an assessee, being a foreign company, the provisions of section 59 shall apply in computing the income chargeable under the head "Income from other sources", as they apply in computing the income chargeable under the head "Profits and gains of business or profession".

legal_units.title: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
legal_units.text: In computing the income from winnings from lotteries, crossword puzzles, races including horse races, card games and other games of any sort, or from gambling or betting of any form or nature, no deduction for any expenditure or allowance related to such income shall be allowed under this Act.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter IV COMPUTATION OF TOTAL INCOME Chapter IV, Division F Income from Other Sources Section 94 Ministry of Finance, Government of India Section 94(4): In computing the income from winnings from lotteries, crossword puzzles, races including horse races, card games and other games of any sort, or from gambling or betting of any form or nature, no deduction for any expenditure or allowance related to such income shall be allowed under this Act.

legal_units.title: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
legal_units.text: Sub-section (4) shall not apply in computing the income of an assessee, being the owner of horses maintained for running in horse races, from the activity of owning and maintaining such horses.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter IV COMPUTATION OF TOTAL INCOME Chapter IV, Division F Income from Other Sources Section 94 Ministry of Finance, Government of India Section 94(5): Sub-section (4) shall not apply in computing the income of an assessee, being the owner of horses maintained for running in horse races, from the activity of owning and maintaining such horses.

legal_units.title: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
legal_units.text: For the purposes of this section, the expression "horse race" means a horse race upon which wagering or betting may be lawfully made.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter IV COMPUTATION OF TOTAL INCOME Chapter IV, Division F Income from Other Sources Section 94 Ministry of Finance, Government of India Section 94(6): For the purposes of this section, the expression "horse race" means a horse race upon which wagering or betting may be lawfully made.
